target_hypothesis: The V0.16 response branching observed inside the exact AMD EPYC 9V74 CPU-model group is stratified by a reproducible numerical runtime state, with CPU capability/HWCAP state tested before FPU-control, binary/runtime-library, NumPy-dispatch and full composite state.
object: Thirty-two new independent GitHub-hosted GRID1024 PURE_PAIR evaluations of the two exact V0.16 replay-failure cells plus the exact GRID1024 anchor. The primary analysis is prospectively restricted to the exact AMD EPYC 9V74 CPU-model subgroup and uses the signed centered beta response (plus-minus)/(2h).

pre_registered_decision.INCONCLUSIVE: If any frozen identity/hash fails, a lane is missing, a response is non-finite, runtime fingerprint completeness fails, anchor spread reaches 1e-5, requested-node binding exceeds 1e-12, or ephemeral provenance enters the classifier, classify NUMERICAL_RUNTIME_STATE_FINGERPRINT_AUDIT_INCONCLUSIVE; no promotion.
pre_registered_decision.SOFTWARE_CONFOUNDED: If the stable software-control signature differs across the 32 jobs, classify NUMERICAL_RUNTIME_STATE_FINGERPRINT_CONFOUNDED_BY_SOFTWARE_CONTROL_VARIATION and authorize only a prospectively frozen controlled software-image factor audit.
pre_registered_decision.TARGET_UNDERPOWERED: If fewer than six jobs match the exact frozen AMD EPYC 9V74 target CPU model, classify NUMERICAL_RUNTIME_STATE_FINGERPRINT_UNDERPOWERED_TARGET_CPU_MODEL and authorize only expanded prospective runtime-state replication.
pre_registered_decision.NOT_REPRODUCED: If the target CPU-model subgroup no longer has replay-failure spread >=1e-5, classify V016_SAME_CPU_MODEL_VARIATION_NOT_REPRODUCED_IN_V017 and authorize only a same-CPU-model variation confirmation audit.
pre_registered_decision.FACTOR_PROMOTION: Otherwise traverse factor_hierarchy in frozen order. A factor can be promoted only when at least two groups each have at least two independent jobs, every repeated group is stable below 1e-5 on both failure cells, and at least one pair of repeated groups differs by >=1e-5 on both failure cells. Map capability to CPU_CAPABILITY_RUNTIME_STATE_STRATIFICATION_SUPPORTED, FPU to FPU_CONTROL_RUNTIME_STATE_STRATIFICATION_SUPPORTED, binary/runtime to BINARY_RUNTIME_STATE_STRATIFICATION_SUPPORTED, NumPy dispatch to NUMPY_DISPATCH_RUNTIME_STATE_STRATIFICATION_SUPPORTED, and full composite to NUMERICAL_RUNTIME_STATE_STRATIFICATION_SUPPORTED. Each result authorizes only its corresponding controlled intervention audit; no causal claim is allowed yet.
pre_registered_decision.SAME_FULL_STATE_VARIATION: If a repeated full_runtime_state_key group still has replay-failure spread >=1e-5, classify RECORDED_NUMERICAL_RUNTIME_STATE_INSUFFICIENT_SAME_STATE_VARIATION and authorize only a prospectively frozen process-initialization/memory-layout audit.
pre_registered_decision.MIXED: Otherwise classify NUMERICAL_RUNTIME_STATE_FINGERPRINT_UNDERPOWERED_OR_MIXED and authorize only expanded runtime-state replication.

interpretation_ceiling: V0.17 may identify a reproducible runtime-state stratifier inside the exact V0.16 CPU-model group. It remains observational and cannot establish a causal CPU/SIMD/FPU/library mechanism without a separate intervention. It cannot validate full Layer-B, covariance, whitening, nuisance treatment, relation-null, Wm_S3, global traversal, dark-sector inference or any physical signal.
